mapper.insert: insert into gas_sms_log( phone, template_code, params, biz_type, biz_id, client_ip, status, provider_biz_id, error_msg, create_time )values( #{phone}, #{templateCode}, #{params}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, 0, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{providerBizId}, #{errorMsg}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select max(create_time) from gas_sms_log where phone = #{phone} and biz_type = #{bizType}
